'''Hevurion''' was an member [[Planet|world]] of the [[New Republic]] about thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]].<ref name="BTA" /> Located in the [[Hevurion system]] in the [[Inner Rim Territories]],<ref name="Appendix" /> it was situated along the [[Hydian Way]] southwest of [[Bogden]].<ref name="Map" /> [[Erudo Ro-Kiintor]] was the [[Senior Senator|senior]] [[senator]] from Hevurion to the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] but used his position to collude with the [[First Order]].<ref name="BTA" /> The [[First Order snowtrooper|snowtrooper]] [[commander]] [[TX-8080]] hailed from Hevurion.<ref name="TROS VD" />
